term: world-relative modal operators and actual truth
definition: Dia F P w means there exists v with F.access w v and P v; Box F P w means every F-accessible v satisfies P. Actual truth is P w. In particular possible collapse is Dia F (MC F D) w and necessary collapse is Box F (MC F D) w, distinct from actual MC F D w. No conceivability predicate or conceivability-to-possibility bridge is assumed.
note: Stipulated mathematical semantics for issue #263, not a historical source attribution or an assertion of metaphysical possibility. A philosophical adoption would require its own pinned source reading.
